study: Phase 2: Sleep Telemetry and ExtraSensory policy-revision screening
selection_status: Exploratory amendment after all phase-1 results were observed: HAR70+ 4.292179848642232%, PAMAP2 0%, UniMiB 0%. No optimization outcomes for Sleep Telemetry or ExtraSensory group-coherent policy revision have been observed. The earlier ExtraSensory row-leakage-repair results are known.

preprocessing.sleeptelemetry: All 22 participants and all 44 original Sleep Telemetry hypnograms. Each scored 30-second epoch is one unit-cost record. Original R&K stages W,1,2,3,4,R retained separately; unscored (?) and movement annotations excluded by the definition of sleep-stage prediction. Group by participant across both nights. Strata are original sleep stage crossed with placebo/temazepam condition from ST-subjects.xls. No trimming of scored wake time, no subsampling or synthetic groups.
preprocessing.extrasensory_revision: All 377346 original observations and all 60 participants, using the already frozen previous activity labels, including unreported activity. Same cohort as the earlier pilot; the newly tested workflow starts with whole participants assigned to folds and revises a group-coherent split under balance constraints.

fold_design: For each seed, permute sorted participant IDs with NumPy default_rng(seed), use array_split into five folds, test every ordered pair of distinct test and validation fold. Total 40 cases per dataset.
original_memberships: Test fold wholly locked; all observations from validation fold start in validation; all remaining participants start in train. Group-consistent original assignments.
comparison: Best independently valid output of all three greedy methods on the identical instance. Cases without a valid greedy answer count as failures, not movement savings. Report every attempted case.

qualification.metric: 100 * sum(greedy_changed - splitmend_changed) / sum(greedy_changed) over ALL paired valid cases from BOTH fixed fold seeds

optimality: Exhaustive participant allocation enumeration for at most 18 free groups; otherwise require solver-reported zero optimality gap and independent row audit. Preserve any time limits.
reporting: Exploratory dataset selection, not a universal or independently validated 20% claim. Preserve previous clinical evidence and the complete candidate screening. GitHub/main changes conditional on verified qualifying evidence and write availability.
